files.text:
Marlow Street Bakery

Hours Menu Cakes

Marlow Street Bakery

A small neighborhood bakery at 14 Marlow Street, on the corner by the library. Everything is baked on site every morning.

Hours

Tuesday to Friday
7:00 am to 3:00 pm
Saturday and Sunday
8:00 am to 2:00 pm
Monday
Closed

Menu

  • Country sourdough loaf$7.50
  • Seeded rye loaf$8.00
  • Butter croissant$3.75
  • Cardamom bun$4.25
  • Morning bun with orange zest$4.00
  • Sourdough focaccia slice$4.50
  • Filter coffee$2.75
  • Oat milk latte$4.75

The cardamom buns usually sell out by 11 am on weekends.

Baked every morning

Everything is baked on site every morning, starting at 4 am. Teo bakes the bread with a sourdough starter he has kept alive since 2016.

Cakes and special orders

Whole cakes and bread for parties need 48 hours' notice. Call us or come by the counter. We don't take orders by email yet.

Call (555) 014-2290

Marlow Street Bakery, 14 Marlow Street

Phone: (555) 014-2290

Marlow Street Bakery is a small neighborhood bakery at 14 Marlow Street, on the corner by the library. Come in for a loaf, a bun and a cup of coffee.
